tasks.description: 1.1 `HW-F01` Implement Colibri ARM64 source build, GLM-5.2 artifact selector, storage estimator/resumable integrity downloader and loopback bounded server; verify architecture/model identity/ENOSPC/cancel fixtures; document experimental route. Evidence: `tests/contracts/test_colibri.py`.

1.2 `HW-F02` Implement configurable cold/warm GLM performance and responsiveness verifier; verify threshold classification fixture and generate executable physical-Pi measurement workflow; document measurements. Evidence: `tests/contracts/test_glm_evidence.py`.

1.3 `HW-F03` Implement USB/PCIe Coral driver/environment adapter and official delegate-used inference verifier; verify driver choice/CPU-fallback rejection fixtures and executable hardware workflow; document isolated runtime. Evidence: `tests/contracts/test_coral.py`.

2.1 `HW-R0041` Implement `R0041` in `src/hermes_installer/components/coral.py`: Coral accelerates compatible, compiled, fully quantized TensorFlow Lite workloads; it does not provide a general accelerator for GLM/Colibri or remote Nemotron inference. Follow Coral's compatibility documentation (https://coral.ai/docs/edgetpu/models-intro/) and the setup guide for the detected device. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_coral.py` (EV-R0041): Native architecture/artifact/device-choice fixture plus executable measured physical-target workflow; CPU or small-model substitution rejected, missing target recorded pending. Update `docs/hardware-inference.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.2 `HW-R0042` Implement `R0042` in `src/hermes_installer/runtime/authorization.py`: Install the appropriate runtime and permissions in an isolated dependency environment. Do not downgrade Hermes or the host Python to satisfy older PyCoral packages. Test actual TPU inference with a small official compiled sample model and record that the TPU delegate was used; device enumeration alone is insufficient. Keep Coral inference separate from LLM model routing. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_authorization.py` (EV-R0042): Denial fixture at actual dispatch/process/filesystem boundary: attempts beyond authorized scope fail before target side effect, including schedule/webhook/delegated identities and fresh lookup failure. Update `docs/hardware-inference.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.3 `HW-R0043` Implement `R0043` in `src/hermes_installer/components/coral.py`: Do not install surveillance or camera services merely to give the TPU a workload. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_coral.py` (EV-R0043): Native architecture/artifact/device-choice fixture plus executable measured physical-target workflow; CPU or small-model substitution rejected, missing target recorded pending. Update `docs/hardware-inference.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.4 `HW-R0044` Implement `R0044` in `src/hermes_installer/downloads.py`: Check available memory, CPU architecture/features, thermals/throttling, storage health where supported, and device access. Never infer performance from the presence of a TPU or a nominal 16 GB RAM label. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_downloads.py` (EV-R0044): HTTP Range/digest and filesystem capacity fixtures: verify required capacity calculation, interrupted resume, mismatch/ENOSPC containment and preservation of prior generation. Update `docs/hardware-inference.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.5 `HW-R0112` Implement `R0112` in `src/hermes_installer/components/colibri.py`: Use JustVugg/colibri (https://github.com/JustVugg/colibri), its current quickstart (https://github.com/JustVugg/colibri/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md), and verified GLM-5.2 model artifacts. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_colibri.py` (EV-R0112): Native architecture/artifact/device-choice fixture plus executable measured physical-target workflow; CPU or small-model substitution rejected, missing target recorded pending. Update `docs/hardware-inference.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.6 `HW-R0113` Implement `R0113` in `src/hermes_installer/components/colibri.py`: Preserve GLM-5.2 as the requested model. At research time the recommended converted package is approximately 429 GB, and upstream lists 16 GB minimum / 24 GB recommended or measured-ready RAM. Its published low-memory laptop result is not a Pi benchmark. Do not assert acceptable performance on this Pi without measurement. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_colibri.py` (EV-R0113): Native architecture/artifact/device-choice fixture plus executable measured physical-target workflow; CPU or small-model substitution rejected, missing target recorded pending. Update `docs/hardware-inference.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.7 `HW-R0114` Implement `R0114` in `src/hermes_installer/components/colibri.py`: Implement the complete experimental local-model path: Verify with `tests/contracts/test_colibri.py` (EV-R0114): Native architecture/artifact/device-choice fixture plus executable measured physical-target workflow; CPU or small-model substitution rejected, missing target recorded pending. Update `docs/hardware-inference.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.8 `HW-R0115` Implement `R0115` in `src/hermes_installer/downloads.py`: Build the engine for actual Linux ARM64; do not download an x86-only Linux binary. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_downloads.py` (EV-R0115): HTTP Range/digest and filesystem capacity fixtures: verify required capacity calculation, interrupted resume, mismatch/ENOSPC containment and preservation of prior generation. Update `docs/hardware-inference.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.9 `HW-R0116` Implement `R0116` in `src/hermes_installer/components/colibri.py`: Resolve a supported, licensed, revision-pinned model artifact and quantization, including any required MTP data. Never silently substitute GLM-5.3 or a smaller model. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_colibri.py` (EV-R0116): Native architecture/artifact/device-choice fixture plus executable measured physical-target workflow; CPU or small-model substitution rejected, missing target recorded pending. Update `docs/hardware-inference.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.10 `HW-R0117` Implement `R0117` in `src/hermes_installer/downloads.py`: Show total download, temporary/conversion, final-storage, and update/rollback space requirements before the user selects the large download. Support an existing model path and resumable integrity-checked downloads. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_downloads.py` (EV-R0117): HTTP Range/digest and filesystem capacity fixtures: verify required capacity calculation, interrupted resume, mismatch/ENOSPC containment and preservation of prior generation. Update `docs/hardware-inference.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.11 `HW-R0118` Implement `R0118` in `src/hermes_installer/downloads.py`: Reserve space for the OS, Hermes, user data, caches, logs, and recovery. Avoid duplicating hundreds of gigabytes solely to create a generic backup. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_downloads.py` (EV-R0118): HTTP Range/digest and filesystem capacity fixtures: verify required capacity calculation, interrupted resume, mismatch/ENOSPC containment and preservation of prior generation. Update `docs/hardware-inference.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.12 `HW-R0119` Implement `R0119` in `src/hermes_installer/downloads.py`: Measure memory use, SSD throughput, first-token latency, prompt processing, token generation, and tool-use behavior on this host. Distinguish cold and warm tests. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_downloads.py` (EV-R0119): HTTP Range/digest and filesystem capacity fixtures: verify required capacity calculation, interrupted resume, mismatch/ENOSPC containment and preservation of prior generation. Update `docs/hardware-inference.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.13 `HW-R0120` Implement `R0120` in `src/hermes_installer/components/colibri.py`: Give the model a bounded, cancellable service and an authenticated/loopback API adapter appropriate to the current Colibri server. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_colibri.py` (EV-R0120): Native architecture/artifact/device-choice fixture plus executable measured physical-target workflow; CPU or small-model substitution rejected, missing target recorded pending. Update `docs/hardware-inference.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.14 `HW-R0121` Implement `R0121` in `src/hermes_installer/components/colibri.py`: Keep Desktop responsive. Restrict concurrent local inference and suspend competing installer-managed heavy workloads where necessary. Do not promise that swap solves insufficient physical RAM. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_colibri.py` (EV-R0121): Native architecture/artifact/device-choice fixture plus executable measured physical-target workflow; CPU or small-model substitution rejected, missing target recorded pending. Update `docs/hardware-inference.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.15 `HW-R0122` Implement `R0122` in `src/hermes_installer/components/colibri.py`: Enable it as an interactive default only if measured behavior satisfies documented, configurable acceptance thresholds. Otherwise retain an explicitly experimental/manual route with its measured limitations. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_colibri.py` (EV-R0122): Native architecture/artifact/device-choice fixture plus executable measured physical-target workflow; CPU or small-model substitution rejected, missing target recorded pending. Update `docs/hardware-inference.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.16 `HW-R0123` Implement `R0123` in `src/hermes_installer/downloads.py`: Build this support even if the target hardware is unavailable during development. Clearly separate implementing the installation path from having downloaded and tested the model on the actual Pi. An optional smaller model can be offered separately; it must never count as the requested GLM model passing. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_downloads.py` (EV-R0123): HTTP Range/digest and filesystem capacity fixtures: verify required capacity calculation, interrupted resume, mismatch/ENOSPC containment and preservation of prior generation. Update `docs/hardware-inference.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.
